title: Wang & Chu 2023, Effects of Post-Annealing on ZnO:Ga Films (Materials 16, 6463)
notes: One deposition recipe, then post-annealing 1 h in N2 or H2(15%)/N2 at 400-550 °C.
The 15% H2 is the ANNEALING forming gas, not the sputtering gas: h2_ratio has no gold value.
Resistivities of HN400/HN500/HN550 are figure-only (Fig. 1) and not recorded.
The 200 nm / 32 Ω/sq / 84% ITO and the 1.97e-4 Ω·cm commercial ITO are literature references.

mode.raw: GZO thin films were deposited using RF magnetron sputtering

sputtering_power.raw: The deposition parameter was 60 W for 30 min at 2 mtorr with 3 sccm argon
